description: Test suite for the image policy admission webhook in Kubernetes, including server setup, TLS configuration, annotation filtering, and cache behavior.

methods.name: TestNewFromConfig
methods.description: Tests creation of the webhook from various kubeconfig templates, checking for proper error handling.

methods.name: NewTestServer
methods.description: Creates a test HTTPS server simulating the remote image review service.

methods.name: newImagePolicyWebhook
methods.description: Creates a new image policy webhook plugin with a temporary kubeconfig.

methods.name: TestTLSConfig
methods.description: Tests TLS configuration and mutual authentication between client and server.

methods.name: testWebhookCacheCases
methods.description: Helper to test caching behavior of webhook responses.

methods.name: TestWebhookCache
methods.description: Verifies that successful responses are cached and errors are not.

methods.name: TestContainerCombinations
methods.description: Tests admission decisions based on various container configurations in pods.

methods.name: TestDefaultAllow
methods.description: Tests the default allow/deny behavior when backend is unreachable.

methods.name: TestAnnotationFiltering
methods.description: Ensures only specific annotations are forwarded to the webhook.

methods.name: TestReturnedAnnotationAdd
methods.description: Checks that annotations returned by the webhook are correctly added to the pod.
